definitions.explanation: A school that only admits male students. In Japan, single-sex schools exist mainly at the private middle school and high school levels.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{男子校|だんしこう}に{通|かよ}っている。
{男子校|だんしこう}から{共学|きょうがく}に{変|か}わる{学校|がっこう}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: More and more schools are changing from all-boys to co-ed.

examples.japanese: {男子校|だんしこう}で{六年間|ろくねんかん}{過|す}ごしたので、{大学|だいがく}に{入|はい}るまで{女子|じょし}と{話|はな}す{機会|きかい}がほとんどなかった。
examples.english: Since I spent six years at an all-boys school, I had almost no opportunity to talk with girls until I entered university.

notes:
USAGE:
{男子校|だんしこう} is short for {男子|だんし}{学校|がっこう}. In Japan, single-sex schools are primarily private and often have long histories and traditions.
Many traditional {男子校|だんしこう} in Japan have been converting to {共学|きょうがく} in recent decades due to declining birth rates and changing social norms.

RELATED WORDS:
- {女子校|じょしこう} (girls' school)
- {共学|きょうがく} (co-educational school)
- {別学|べつがく} (single-sex education)
